links.outcome: Local ambient scribe assessment of usability, clinician well-being, time in notes, and workload before and after implementation
links.effect: Time in notes per appointment fell from 6.2 to 5.3 minutes (P<.001); NASA-TLX mental demand 12.2 to 6.3; burnout 42.1% to 35.1% (P=.12); benefit varied by sex and specialty.
links.quote: Mean (SD) time in notes per appointment significantly decreased from 6.2 (4.0) to 5.3 (3.5) minutes (P < .001), with a bigger decrease for female vs male clinicians (8.1 [3.9] to 6.7 [3.6] minutes vs 4.7 [3.5] to 4.2 [3.1] minutes; P = .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an ambient AI documentation tool on clinician well-being and EHR metrics before and after implementation, without testing an explicit deployment practice or guardrail variation.
